assessments.description: 32-36 bar piece from the 1st Year Repertoire List (on Canvas), arranged for 4 horns (Trumpet, Alto Sax, Tenor Sax and Trombone) for the complete form - no rhythm section component.

assessments.description: Selecting a 32-36 bar piece from the 1st Year Repertoire List or 1st Year Vocal List, arrange a piece for 4 horns (Tpt, Alto Sax, Tenor Sax, Trombone) + rhythm section (Guitar, Piano, Bass, Drums) demonstrating skills in voicing.
